events.name: DOWNTOWN ERIE EVENTS
events.description: Visit Flagship City District in Downtown Erie! Enjoy a meal from the Food Hall, explore one-of-a-kind shops, and make new memories our vibrant neighborhood!

events.name: Karaoke @ the Food Hall
events.description: Karaoke night in Downtown Erie at Flagship City Food Hall featuring local host Preach Freedom. Enjoy Happy Hour at IPPA and a high-energy night of music, food, and fun.

events.name: 8 Great Tuesdays
events.description: 8 Great Tuesdays presented by PNC Bank is a FREE community concert series that takes place at the Rebich Investments Amphitheater throughout July and August featuring a variety of local and regional bands.

events.name: Lopaka Rootz & KT @ the Food Hall
events.description: Enjoy live music in Downtown Erie every week at Flagship City Food Hall. Featuring local musicians across genres like R&B, folk rock, jazz, pop, and more. Try some food from multiple kitchens, drink specials, and a relaxed atmosphere.
